**6408 Ekkocardiografi** is a specific medical procedure code registered in the Danish [[sygesikringsregisteret|Sygesikringsregisteret]] (National Health Service Register) [^src1]. It is utilized to identify and track [[ekkokardiografi|echocardiographic]] examinations within the Danish healthcare system [^src2]. 

Within the context of the national clinical quality database for atrial fibrillation (Atrieflimren i Danmark, or AFDK), managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), this code plays a vital role in quality measurement [^src1]. Specifically, it helps calculate clinical quality indicators by identifying patients who have undergone an echocardiogram as part of their diagnostic workup and follow-up for atrial fibrillation [^src3]. Standardized data collection using precise procedure codes like 6408 enables consistent monitoring and comparison of treatment quality across Danish regions [^src1].

The Sygesikringsregisteret utilizes a specific set of codes to capture various types of echocardiography procedures. Alongside **6408 Ekkocardiografi**, the register includes codes such as [[2208-ekkocardiografi|2208 Ekkocardiografi]], [[3810-ekkocardiografi-standardundersoegelse|3810 Ekkocardiografi, standardundersøgelse]], [[3811-ekkocardiografi-avanceret-undersoegelse|3811 Ekkocardiografi, avanceret undersøgelse]], [[5101-ekko-cardiografi|5101 EKKO-cardiografi]], [[5102-transsofageal-ekko|5102 Transsøfofagal ekko]], [[5103-stress-ekkocardiogra|5103 Stress ekkocardiogra]], [[6402-ekkocardiografi|6402 Ekkocardiografi]], and [[0906-ekko-kardiografi|0906 Ekko-kardiografi]] [^src1]. Together, these codes ensure that all relevant cardiac imaging interventions are accurately recorded for epidemiological and quality assurance purposes [^src3].
